full_page.content:
1943, February 28
V. Brother Leo, O.F.M. Cap.
Page 2
was about to fall the third time He patiently con- soled the women-folks and children of His persecutors, making no exceptions. How can we ever be grateful as we ought to be for such a vocation - to such privileg- ed positions - even in the Seraphic Order of the Poverello of Asissi? .. ... Thanks be to God that He has such divine patience with us. .... One of the secrets no doubt, as you surely have seen from "The Mystical City of God," is the fact that our Blessed Mother Mary is always coaching poor sinners on the one hand to confidence and penance, and on the other Jesus our Lord to have mercy and spare.
Thanks be to God! Praised Jesus eternally and Mary, our Bl. Mother!
Fr. Solanus, O. F.M. Cap.
P.S. Talking with Father Provincial last Wednesday he said we'd go back to Detroit together. He has been working on the Messenger and I think very probably we will be leaving here shortly - possibly Tuesday or Wednesday. I cannot say just when.
God bless you again. Very best regards to V. Bro. Francis and to all our Dear ones.
